rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for other people or things not previously referred to.

example.english: The other people have already left, so only we are left.
example.traditional: 其他人已經走咗，得返我哋。
example.jyutping: kei4 taa1 jan4 ji5 ging1 zau2 zo2 dak1 faan1 ngo5 dei6

rows.note: Use this for the singular other one when contrasting it with a specific one already mentioned.

example.english: This cold drink is mine; the other one is yours.
example.traditional: 呢杯凍飲係我嘅，另一個先係你嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 bui1 dung3 jam2 hai6 ngo5 ge3 ling6 jat1 go3 sin1 hai6 nei5 ge3
